Is Tuition Really Necessary? Here’s What Parents Should Consider

Every child learns differently. While some students are able to keep up with classroom teaching, others may need additional guidance to strengthen concepts, build confidence, or keep pace with the syllabus. Tuition isn’t just about scoring higher marks—it’s about providing a structured learning environment where students can ask questions freely, clear doubts, and receive individual attention.

The right coaching support can also help students develop better study habits, improve time management, and stay consistent throughout the academic year. Regular assessments and timely feedback allow students to identify areas of improvement before exams approach, reducing stress and boosting confidence.

Parents should choose a coaching institute that focuses on concept clarity, personalised guidance, and continuous progress rather than rote learning alone. A strong academic foundation today can make future learning much easier and prepare students for both school examinations and higher education.

At Mayank Tutorials, we are committed to helping students learn with confidence through structured teaching, experienced faculty, and a supportive learning environment.

📍 Visit your nearest Mayank Tutorials centre to know more about our academic programmes and admissions.

How to Build a Study Routine That Actually Works

A good study routine isn’t about spending long hours at your desk—it’s about studying consistently and with purpose. Breaking the syllabus into manageable goals, revising regularly, and practising questions every week can help students retain concepts better and reduce exam stress. featured_reviews.name: Ajay Dhiman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review of NK Academy by my son:

My name is Ansh Dhiman, and I have been studying here since 2023-2026, I had a wonderful time studying with excellent teachers such as- Narendra sir, Sachin sir, Purvi ma’am, Neha ma’am, Anagha ma’am, etc. They have helped me a lot on my academic journey and clear some of my doubts along the way which transcended my school syllabus.

The teachers here are highly experienced and I feel very grateful for being taught by them. I highly recommend joining NK Academy if you are weak in academics, or even if you are doing good because there is always a thing or two that you would definitely learn from them.

The teachers also provide extensive study materials which are always a worth going through, ensuring that their support to us is constant.

You are also allowed to arrange separate lectures or alter the timings according to your wish so that you get utmost time for self study, etc.

In a nutshell, joining this institute will definitely be worth it!
